title: 商易通 MCP 用户配置
description: 填写您的商易通开放平台 MCP Token。WorkBuddy 将凭证保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，仅用于访问商易通企业数据查询服务，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your ShangYiTong open platform MCP token. WorkBuddy stores the credential locally in ~/.workbuddy and uses it only to access ShangYiTong enterprise data services; it is never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 如何获取商易通 MCP Token？
docLabel_en: How to get a ShangYiTong MCP Token?

fields.label: MCP Token
fields.placeholder: 登录商易通开放平台后，粘贴以 mcp_ 开头的 Token
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in to the ShangYiTong open platform, then paste the token beginning with mcp_
fields.description: 用于连接商易通 MCP 服务并鉴权访问企业工商、股权人员、上市与司法风险等数据。将以 Authorization: Bearer 形式注入请求头。Token 泄露或失效时，请在商易通开放平台作废并重新生成后更新此处。不要把真实 Token 写入 Skill、代码、截图或日志。
fields.description_en: Connects to the ShangYiTong MCP service to access enterprise registry, equity/personnel, listing and judicial risk data. Injected into the request header as Authorization: Bearer. If the token leaks or expires, revoke and regenerate it on the ShangYiTong open platform, then update it here. Never put the real token in skills, code, screenshots, or logs.
